reviews.text: A colorful shmup that reminds me of Luftrausers. ETA: Unknown
Let the inner speed demon loose in an explosive rogue like. Blasting enemies out of the sky in aerial combat, while kickass music blasts through your speakers. This isn't a scrap, it's a dogfight.
By the creator of [Akane]. Keep an eye out for this one! More info coming soon! ('Coming Early 2021')”
This game is not a roguelike.
Gives me Luftrausers vibes, but with much more color, and potentially more meta progression. Could be easier to get into as well - a schmup worth keeping your eye on.
The latest joint from Akane devs has been a while coming, but it looks superb and I really hope they can release it

Take the skies in this side-scrolling rougelike with intense aerial combat. Rebel against your oppressors in this adrenaline induced game. Challenge powerful 3D mecha beasts for your chance at freedom
3D low-poly, mechas, and lots of shooting
